title: BPBond 솔로 #052 · 누비안부티빌더 · Mexican Talavera ceramic · 금 세트 벽 구속 · a glossy nude-pink lip
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult German woman in her mid 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair cool-toned skin, soft taupe eyeshadow, a glossy nude-pink lip, cool and composed, elegant updo hair, real living eyes. Long coffin nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Mexican Talavera ceramic — a glossy white tin glaze with cobalt blue and marigold medallions, wide cobalt bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense medallion scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: She wears a wide polished gold neck ring closed with a thick gold pin, with a heavy gold ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of chunky thick polished gold links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a large polished gold ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her wrists wear wide polished gold shackles, hinged bands closed with a thick gold pin, each with a heavy gold ring, each ring linked by a short chain of the same chunky polished gold links, up and outward to its own large polished gold ring bolted into the stone wall high on its own side, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head. Her ankles wear wide polished gold shackles, hinged bands closed with a thick gold pin, each with a heavy gold ring, each ring linked by a short chain of the same chunky polished gold links, down and outward to its own large polished gold ring bolted into the base of the stone wall on its own side.

Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head, her legs spread apart, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: Extreme cobalt extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
